name: Nijowari: Where Angels Fall
source:
William Steele
"I was just an ordinary kid when my world blew up."

William Steele, a young man with a calling and our first main character, discovers that his region is home and that is worth protecting.

Bent on helping his community, he ends up becoming a "fixer", a counselor, sometimes friend, always driven to help people who deserve it.

Adeia Berith
"It's not time to overthink... It's time to enjoy!"

Adeia Berith, our second main character, is a coy, fearful, and innocent newcomer to Nijowari, a strange city with a peculiar society.

Trusting the world she's about to enter is as gentle as her, she's forced to find her way, ultimately discovering a dark reality nobody knew existed.

Along the way, both William and Adeia meet a cast of supporting characters that change their fates, for the better and the worse.

[From [url=https://kyoki-chiho.itch.io/nijowari-where-angels-fall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
威廉．斯蒂爾
「我的世界崩塌時，我還只是個普通的孩子。」

威廉．斯蒂爾是我們的第一位主角，一位心懷使命的年輕人。他逐漸明白，自己生活的這片地方就是家園，值得守護。

他一心想幫助社區，最終成了一名「麻煩解決者」，為人排憂解難，有時也成為對方的朋友，始終致力於幫助那些值得幫助的人。

阿黛婭．貝里斯
「現在不是想太多的時候……而是享受的時候！」

我們的第二位主角阿黛婭．貝里斯，是一位靦腆、膽怯而天真的新來者，剛剛來到尼喬瓦里——一座擁有奇特社會的古怪城市。

她相信即將踏入的世界也與自己一樣溫柔，卻不得不摸索著尋找自己的道路，最終發現了一片從未有人知曉的黑暗現實。

一路上，威廉與阿黛婭都會遇見許多配角，改變兩人的命運，有的使之變好，有的使之變壞。

[摘自[url=https://kyoki-chiho.itch.io/nijowari-where-angels-fall]Itch.io[/url]]
